description:
Create a 3-circle Venn diagram in EdrawMax comparing cloud service models. 

1. Open EdrawMax and create a new Venn Diagram (found under Basic Diagram > Business, or by searching 'Venn'). Alternatively, draw three overlapping circles manually.
2. Arrange the circles in a standard triangular overlap configuration.
3. Add a title text box at the top: 'Cloud Service Models Comparison'.
4. Label the three main circles: 'IaaS', 'PaaS', and 'SaaS'.
5. Add the following text inside the unique (non-overlapping) regions of each circle:
   - IaaS circle: 'Virtual Machines'
   - PaaS circle: 'App Engine'
   - SaaS circle: 'Office Suite'
6. Add text in the center region where all three circles overlap: 'Scalability'.
7. Apply different fill colors to each circle and ensure they have transparency so the overlaps are visible.
8. Save the diagram to '/home/ga/Documents/cloud_services_venn.eddx'.

Note: If any startup dialogs appear, close them.
